integrity: Proof gives the complete recursion and positivity argument; exact fractional enumeration is corroborative, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Exact covariance and strict sign for fixed positive root weight only; no full joint distribution or joint independence assertion. Uniform case is implicitly encompassed by published generating-function theory, so the contribution is the full root-weight family and sharp asymptotic. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Universal leaf/path-length anticorrelation in root-biased Hoppe trees
